basics.description:
**Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Check%20Point%20Cyberint%20Alerts/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Check Point provides Microsoft Sentinel integration to streamline critical Alerts and bring enriched threat intelligence from the Infinity External Risk Management solution into Microsoft Sentinel. This simplifies the process of tracking the status of tickets with automatic sync updates across systems. Using this new integration for Microsoft Sentinel, existing Check Point Exposure Management and Microsoft Sentinel customers can easily pull logs based on Check Point Exposure Management findings into Microsoft Sentinel platform.

NOTE: Microsoft recommends installation of Check Point Exposure Management Alerts Connector (via Codeless Connector Platform). This connector is build on the Codeless Connector Platform (CCP), which uses the Log Ingestion API, which replaces ingestion via the deprecated HTTP Data Collector API. CCP-based data connectors also support Data Collection Rules (DCRs) offering transformations and enrichment.

**Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 2, **Playbooks:** 8 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Check Point Cyberint Alerts Connector (via Codeless Connector Platform). You can get Check Point Cyberint Alerts Connector (via Codeless Connector Platform) data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.

elements.name: workbook1
elements.label: Check Point Exposure Management - Alert Overview

options.text: Gain insights into Check Point Exposure Management alerts ingested into Microsoft Sentinel. Monitor alert volumes, severity distribution, status changes, and sync health between Sentinel and Check Point Exposure Management.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: Check Point Exposure Management - Alert Ingestion Anomaly

options.text:
Detects when no Check Point Exposure Management alerts have been ingested into the argsentdc_CL table
for an extended period. This may indicate a failure in the CCP data connector, a
misconfigured API token, or network connectivity issues.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Check Point Exposure Management - Argos alerts to incidents

options.text:
Creates a Microsoft Sentinel incident for each open Check Point Exposure Management alert
ingested into the argsentdc_CL table by the CCP data connector. Each result becomes its own
alert, and ref_id is surfaced as a Custom Detail so the CPEM Exporter playbook can map the
incident back to the originating Argos alert through
properties.alerts[*].properties.additionalData['Custom Details'].

This rule replaces the Importer playbook's Log Ingestion API path. The Logs Ingestion API
does not support writing to the built-in SecurityAlert table, and a scheduled analytic rule
produces the attached alert and Custom Details natively, with no data collection endpoint,
data collection rule, managed identity or role assignment.

queryPeriod is deliberately much larger than queryFrequency. The connector's DCR maps the
alert's update_date into TimeGenerated, so a row carries a timestamp several minutes older
than the moment it becomes queryable. A window equal to the run interval would miss it.
Repeat matches are folded into the existing incident by grouping on the ref_id custom detail.

This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
